messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":21,"chapter":15,"text":"Just as they do yet this day to my chosen, so I will do also, and repay into their bosom.” The Lord God says:"},{"verse":22,"chapter":15,"text":"“My right hand won’t spare the sinners, and my sword won’t cease over those who shed innocent blood on the earth."},{"verse":23,"chapter":15,"text":"A fire has gone out from his wrath and has consumed the foundations of the earth and the sinners, like burnt straw."},{"verse":24,"chapter":15,"text":"Woe to those who sin and don’t keep my commandments!” says the Lord."},{"verse":25,"chapter":15,"text":"“I will not spare them. Go your way, you rebellious children! Don’t defile my sanctuary!”"}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":15}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
